info.title: Writer API
info.description: HTTP API of the Writer service, the contract of record for its clients.

post.summary:
Create a document, or return the existing document with the same
identifier.

200.description: A document with this identifier already exists; nothing changed.

Location.description: The path of the new document.

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON.

409.description: The identifier belongs to a folder, or `parentId` or `beforeId` names no item there.

413.description: The request body exceeds the size limit.

415.description: The request body is not sent as application/json.

422.description: The request body breaks the schema or a workspace rule; `errors` names each field.

get.summary: Read a document's metadata and revision.
Read a document's content and revision.

500.description: The service failed unexpectedly, or the stored content cannot be served.

put.summary:
Save a document's whole content if it has not changed since
`baseRevision`.

200.description: Saved the content, or found it already stored; the document carries the new revision.

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON.

409.description: The stored content changed after `baseRevision`; nothing changed.

413.description: The request body exceeds the size limit.

415.description: The request body is not sent as application/json.

422.description: The request body breaks the schema or a workspace rule; `errors` names each field.

500.description: The service failed unexpectedly, or the stored content cannot be served.

get.summary: Report that the service can serve requests.

Report whether the pair writer is ready to answer and, if not, what is
missing.

200.description: Whether the pair writer is ready and, if not, what is missing.

post.summary: Stream a pair-writer reply for one conversation turn.
post.description:
Streams `text/event-stream` with `delta` (`ChatReplyDelta`) events, ending
in either a `done` (`ChatReplyDone`) event or an `error` (`Problem`) event.

200.description: Server-sent event stream (`text/event-stream`). Events: `delta` (`ChatReplyDelta`), ending with `done` (`ChatReplyDone`) or `error` (`Problem`).

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON.

413.description: The request body exceeds the size limit.

415.description: The request body is not sent as application/json.

422.description: The request body breaks the schema or a workspace rule; `errors` names each field.

503.description: The pair writer is not configured or not ready.

post.summary: Review changed paragraphs or scenes for provisional background findings.

200.description: Advice-only background findings for the changed passages.

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON.

413.description: The request body exceeds the size limit.

415.description: The request body is not sent as application/json.

422.description: The request body breaks the schema or a workspace rule; `errors` names each field.

502.description: The pair-writer provider failed before completing the review.

503.description: The pair writer is not configured or not ready.

504.description: The pair-writer provider timed out before completing the review.

200.description: Every folder and document, in pre-order.

ChatContextDocument.description: Another document added to the turn with `+ Context`.

ChatDocumentInput.description:
The open document as it stands when the writer sends, unsaved edits
included.

content.description:
Current Markdown or prose text of the open document (or its window
around the selection or cursor when past the reading limit).

cursorOffset.description:
Approximate character offset of the caret in `content` when no
selection is active.

scope.description: Scope used if the caller already windowed a document past the limit.

ChatFindingInput.description: A pinned finding handed off from the Findings tab to a Chat thread.

ChatHistoryMessage.description: One earlier message in the active thread.

ChatHistoryRole.description: Who spoke an earlier turn in a thread.

ChatReadSource.description: One source recorded in a reply's `done` event for `What it read`.

ChatReplyDelta.description: Payload of a `delta` SSE event carrying streamed reply text.

ChatReplyDone.description:
Payload of a `done` SSE event carrying the facts `What it read` shows and
runtime timing and token counts for audit and measurement.

oneOf.description:
Timing and token counts reported by the model runtime, or `null` when
none are reported.

promptVersion.description: Prompt name and digest when a prompt is used, or `null` otherwise.

ChatReplyMetrics.description: Timing and token counts reported by the model runtime for one reply.

evalMs.description: Milliseconds spent generating output tokens, when reported.

firstTokenMs.description: Milliseconds from sending the model request to the first visible reply token.

loadMs.description: Milliseconds spent loading the model into memory, when reported.

outputTokens.description: Number of output tokens generated, when reported.

promptEvalMs.description: Milliseconds spent evaluating the prompt, when reported.

promptTokens.description: Number of prompt tokens evaluated, when reported.

totalMs.description: Total milliseconds reported by the model runtime for the reply.

ChatSelectionInput.description: The editor's active selection, used as the turn's focus.

ChatSourceKind.description: The kind of source recorded in `What it read`.

CreateDocumentRequest.description: A document to create with a client-generated identifier.

beforeId.description: The sibling to create it before, or `null` for the end.

documentId.description: A new lowercase hyphenated UUID, generated by the client.

language.description: The document's BCP 47 language tag (`en` or `es`); `en` when omitted.

markdown.description:
The initial content, at most 1 MiB of UTF-8 without U+0000; empty
when omitted.

parentId.description: The folder to create it in, or `null` for the top level.

title.description:
1 to 200 characters with no surrounding whitespace or control
characters.

CreateFolderRequest.description: A folder to create with a client-generated identifier.

beforeId.description: The sibling to create it before, or `null` for the end.

folderId.description: A new lowercase hyphenated UUID, generated by the client.

parentId.description: The folder to create it in, or `null` for the top level.

title.description:
1 to 200 characters with no surrounding whitespace or control
characters.

CreatePairWriterReplyRequest.description: A stateless conversation turn sent to the pair writer.

document.description: The open document as it stands.

finding.description: Optional pinned finding when the thread was opened from the Findings tab.

history.description: Earlier messages in the current thread, oldest first.

message.description: The writer's question or prompt for this turn.

selection.description: Optional active selection in the open document.

CreatePairWriterReviewRequest.description: Request to review changed paragraphs or scenes of one document.

documentWordCount.description: Optional document word count for quietness gates and `What it read`.

passages.description: Changed paragraphs or scenes to review, in reading order.

Document.description: A document's metadata and the revision of its content.

language.description: The document's BCP 47 language tag (`en` or `es`).

parentId.description: The containing folder, or `null` at the top level.

revision.description:
An opaque token that changes whenever the content changes; compare
it only for equality.

DocumentContent.description: A document's content and its revision.

markdown.description: The document's Markdown, exactly as stored.

FindingAnchor.description:
Provisional passage anchor pointing to an exact substring inside one
reviewed passage, using UTF-16 code-unit offsets.

FindingAudit.description: Facts shown in a finding's collapsed `What it read` disclosure.

promptVersion.description: Prompt name and version when a prompt or rule set is used, or `null`.

FindingCategory.description: Category filters defined in ADR 0011 for the Findings tab.

Folder.description: A folder, which holds folders and documents.

parentId.description: The containing folder, or `null` at the top level.

Health.description: Whether the service can serve requests.

PairWriterIssue.description: Why the pair writer is not ready to answer.

PairWriterReviewResponse.description: Advice-only findings produced for one background review request.

promptVersion.description: Prompt name and version when a prompt or rule set is used, or `null`.

PairWriterStatus.description: Whether the pair writer can answer and, if not, what is missing.

detail.description: Short service-authored explanation of what is missing; otherwise `null`.

model.description: Configured model name, or `null` when none is configured.

provider.description: Configured provider name, or `null` when none is configured.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details object describing why a request failed.

detail.description: A short explanation of this occurrence, written by the service.

errors.description: One entry per invalid request body field; otherwise empty.

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated from the response.

ProblemCode.description: The kind of error; treat an unrecognized code according to the status.

ProblemFieldError.description: One invalid field in a request body.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the field, or `""` for the whole body.

ReadingScope.description: How much of the open document a turn reads.

ReplaceContentRequest.description:
A whole new content for a document, checked against the revision the
client's edits started from.

baseRevision.description: The revision of the content the edits started from.

markdown.description: At most 1 MiB of UTF-8 without U+0000.

ReplaceLanguageRequest.description: A new language for a document.

language.description: A supported BCP 47 language tag (`en` or `es`).

ReplacePositionRequest.description: Where to move a folder or document with its subtree.

beforeId.description: The sibling to place the item before, or `null` for the end.

parentId.description: The folder to place the item in, or `null` for the top level.

ReplaceTitleRequest.description: A new title for a folder or document.

title.description:
1 to 200 characters with no surrounding whitespace or control
characters.

ReviewAgentKind.description: The five pause-triggered background agents from ADR 0011.

ReviewPassageInput.description: One changed paragraph or scene sent for provisional background review.

contentHash.description: Content hash of `text` so callers correlate findings with the reviewed snapshot.

index.description: Zero-based block index in reading order within the document.

passageId.description: Client-assigned stable identifier for the paragraph or scene block.

text.description: Plain prose text of the changed paragraph or scene.

items.description:
Every item in pre-order: each folder is followed by its subtree before
its next sibling, and siblings appear in their order.

WorkspaceItem.description: One folder or document in the tree, without content.

language.description:
The document's BCP 47 language tag (`en` or `es`), or `null` for a
folder.

parentId.description: The containing folder, or `null` at the top level.
